# reserve_routes

Reserve-facility terms and public evidence references.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="reserve_routes", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="reserve_routes", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assessed_minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Assessed minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `assessment_delay` | integer | Top-level filter | Assessment delay: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `assessment_group` | string | Top-level filter | Assessment group: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `available_from` | integer | Top-level filter | Available from: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `commercial_reference` | string | Top-level filter | Reference supplied by a commercial source; use the source and period when matching evidence. |
| `currency` | string | Top-level filter | Currency code for the associated monetary fields. Preserve separate currency balances. Public values represented here: `USD`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `debit_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Debit amount, in integer minor units of the applicable currency. Inspect this record type and its source/receipt to distinguish declared values from actual movements. |
| `destination_account_id` | string | Top-level filter | Destination account id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `expires_minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Expires minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `fee_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Charge for this object/operation in minor units; use the applicable product terms for when it is incurred. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `name` | string | Top-level filter | Human-readable name. Names need not be unique; exact filters are case-sensitive. |
| `net_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Net remittance amount after its recorded fee deduction, in minor units. |
| `pending_assessment` | boolean | Top-level filter | Pending assessment: true/false state flag for this record. |
| `published_net_range` | array | Top-level filter | Published net range: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `published_settlement_delay_range` | array | Top-level filter | Published settlement delay range: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `reference` | string | Top-level filter | Business reference on this object; its uniqueness depends on the issuer, entity and period. |
| `reserve_account_id` | string | Top-level filter | Reserve account id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `settlement_delay` | integer | Top-level filter | Settlement delay: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `status` | string | Top-level filter | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `AVAILABLE`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `terms_version` | integer | Top-level filter | Version of the terms used by this object or booking; requests may bind a specific version. |
